name: Surinaamse feestdagen — compleet, 2 talen (1972–2030)
title: Surinaamse feestdagen — compleet, 2 talen (1972–2030)
description: Comprehensive Surinamese national public holidays (Surinaamse feestdagen) 1972-2030, in both vacanza-supported languages: Dutch (nl native) and English (en_US). Each (date, category) pair is one record, multilingual names as columns. Suriname is a sovereign republic in northeastern South America that became independent from the Netherlands on 25 November 1975; vacanza Suriname start_year=1972, covering the late autonomy-period plus the post-independence years. Includes uniquely-Surinamese multicultural holidays reflecting the country's diverse population — Chinees Nieuwjaar, Holi-Phagwa, Ied-Ul-Fitre, Ied-Ul-Adha, Keti Koti Dey (1 July emancipation), Dag der Inheemsen (9 Aug), Dag der Marrons (10 Oct), Divali, and Onafhankelijkheidsdag (25 Nov).
